  exact h1
end Nl2LeanCandidate

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0036 {α β : Type*} {f : α → β} {X Y : Set α} (hX : X ⊆ α) (hY : Y ⊆ α) : f '' (X ∪ Y) ⊆ f '' X ∪ f '' Y := by sorry

theorem final_dev_0036 {α β : Type*} {f : α → β} {X Y : Set α} (hX : X ⊆ α) (hY : Y ⊆ α) : f '' (X ∪ Y) ⊆ f '' X ∪ f '' Y := by
  intro b hb
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := mem_image_of_mem (X ∪ Y) b hb
  obtain (hXa : a ∈ X) | (hYa : a ∈ Y) := by
    cases mem_union_of_mem hX a ha
    cases mem_union_of_mem hY a ha
  · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := mem_image_of_mem X a hXa
    exact Union_le_left (f '' X) (f '' (X ∪ Y)) (f x) (mem_image_of_mem (X ∪ Y) x (Union_mem_left _ _ hx))
    
  · obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := mem_image_of_mem Y a hYa
    exact Union_le_right (f '' Y) (f '' (X ∪ Y)) (f y) (mem_image_of_mem (X ∪ Y) y (Union_mem_right _ _ hy))
end Nl2LeanCandidate

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0060 {α β : Type*} {f : α → β} {X Y : Set α} (hX : X ⊆ A) (hY : Y ⊆ A) : f (X ∪ Y) ⊆ f X ∪ f Y := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0060 {α β : Type*} {f : α → β} {X Y : Set α} (hX : X ⊆ A) (hY : Y ⊆ A) : f (X ∪ Y) ⊆ f X ∪ f Y := by
  intro b hb
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hb
  obtain haX : a ∈ X := by
    exact hX a ha
  obtain haY : a ∈ Y := by
    exact hY a ha
  exact Or.elim (Or.inl haX) (Or.inr haY)
end Nl2LeanCandidate

import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0101 (a b c d : Nat) (h1 : a ∣ b) (h2 : c ∣ d) : a * c ∣ b * d := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0101 (a b c d : Nat) (h1 : a ∣ b) (h2 : c ∣ d) : a * c ∣ b * d := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk1⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨l, hk2⟩ := h2
  have : b * d = (k * b) * (l * d) := by ring
  rw [this]
  have : (k * b) * (l * d) = (k * l) * (b * d) := by ring
  have : (k * l) * (b * d) = (k * l) * (a * (b / a) * d) := by
    rw [hk1, Nat.mul_assoc]
  have : (k * l) * (a * (b / a) * d) = (a * (k * l * (b / a))) * d := by ring
  have : a * (k * l * (b / a)) * d = (a * c) * (k * (b / a) * (d / c)) * (c * 1) := by
    rw [Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_assoc, h2]
  have : (a * c) * (k * (b / a) * (d / c)) * (c * 1) = (a * c) * (b * (d / c)) := by ring
  have : (a * c) * (b * (d / c)) = (a * c) * (b * (d / c)) := by ring
  exact this
end Nl2LeanCandidate

    ext x
    split
    · intro h
      have h2 : x ∈ A := by
        exact h
      have h3 : x ∉ A \ B := by
        intro h4
        have h5 : x ∈ A := by
          exact h2
        have h6 : x ∉ B := by
          exact h4
        contradiction
      exact h2

      have h2 : x ∈ B := by
        exact h
      have h3 : x ∈ A := by
        exact h
      exact h2
  exact card_eq_of_subsets h1
end Nl2LeanCandidate

import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0129 (l1 l2 : List Nat) : (l1 ++ l2).length = l1.length + l2.length := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0129 (l1 l2 : List Nat) : (l1 ++ l2).length = l1.length + l2.length := by
  induction l1 with
  | nil => simp [List.append]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    induction l2 with
    | nil => simp [List.append, Nat.add_zero]
    | cons y ys =>
      simp [List.append, ih, Nat.add_assoc]
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0129 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0129 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0129

end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0149 (a b c d : Nat) (h1 : a ∣ b) (h2 : c ∣ d) : a * c ∣ b * d := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk1⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨l, hk2⟩ := h2
  have : b * d = (k * b) * (l * d) := by ring
  rw [this]
  have : (k * b) * (l * d) = (k * l) * (b * d) := by ring
  have : (k * l) * (b * d) = (k * l) * (a * (b / a) * d) := by
    rw [hk1, mul_assoc, mul_comm b (b / a), mul_assoc, mul_comm (b / a) d]
  have : (k * l) * (a * (b / a) * d) = (a * (k * l * (b / a))) * d := by ring
  have : a * (k * l * (b / a)) * d = (a * c) * (k * (b / a) * (d / c)) * (c * d) / (c * d) := by
    rw [mul_assoc, mul_comm (k * l * (b / a)), mul_assoc, mul_comm d, div_mul_div]
  have : (a * c) * (k * (b / a) * (d / c)) * (c * d) / (c * d) = (a * c) * (b / a) * (d / c) := by
    ring
  exact this

import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0156 {A B : Type} [fintype A] [fintype B] {f : A → B} (X Y : set A) : f '' (X ∪ Y) ⊆ f '' X ∪ f '' Y := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0156 {A B : Type} [fintype A] [fintype B] {f : A → B} (X Y : set A) : f '' (X ∪ Y) ⊆ f '' X ∪ f '' Y := by
  intro b
  obtain a | a := mem_or_not_mem b (f '' (X ∪ Y))
  · obtain ha | ha := mem_or_not_mem b (f '' X)
    · obtain hX | hX := mem_or_not_mem a X
      · exact or.inl (mem_image_of_mem _ hX)
      · exact or.inr (mem_image_of_mem _ hX)
    · exact or.inl (mem_image_of_mem _ ha)
  · obtain hY | hY := mem_or_not_mem a Y
    · exact or.inl (mem_image_of_mem _ hY)
    · exact or.inr (mem_image_of_mem _ hY)
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0156 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0156 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0156

namespace Nl2LeanExpected

  card (A Δ B) = card (A Δ (A ∩ B)) + card ((A ∩ B) Δ (A ∪ B)) + card (A ∪ B Δ A ∪ B) := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0179 (A B : Set α) : 
  card (A Δ B) = card (A Δ (A ∩ B)) + card ((A ∩ B) Δ (A ∪ B)) + card (A ∪ B Δ A ∪ B) := by
  simp only [card_symmdiff, symmdiff_eq, card_empty, card_eq_zero, union_eq_self, inter_eq_self, diff_empty, diff_self]

end Nl2LeanCandidate

import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0203 {α : Type _} (A B : Set α) : card (A ∪ B) = card A + card B - card (A ∩ B) := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0203 {α : Type _} (A B : Set α) : card (A ∪ B) = card A + card B - card (A ∩ B) := by
  classical
  have h1 : card (A ∪ B) = card A + card (B \ A) := by
    rw [Set.union_eq_add_diff_inter]
  have h2 : card (B \ A) = card B - card (A ∩ B) := by
    rw [Set.diff_eq_sub, Set.inter_eq_self_of_subset, Set.subset_def, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_inter, Set.mem_singleton]
    exact fun x => by
      cases x
      exact Set.mem_singleton_self x
  rw [h1, h2]
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0203 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0203 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0204 {A B : Type*} [fintype A] [fintype B] {f : A → B} (X Y : set A) : f '' (X ∪ Y) ⊆ f '' X ∪ f '' Y := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0204 {A B : Type*} [fintype A] [fintype B] {f : A → B} (X Y : set A) : f '' (X ∪ Y) ⊆ f '' X ∪ f '' Y := by
  intro b
  obtain h : ∃ a, a ∈ X ∪ Y ∧ f a = b := mem_image_of_mem (X ∪ Y) f b
  obtain a | h := classical.dec h
  · obtain h1 : a ∈ X := classical.choice h.1
    obtain h2 : f a ∈ f '' X := by
      rw [mem_image] at h1
      exact h1
    exact h2 ∨ h2
    
  · obtain h1 : a ∈ Y := classical.choice h.1
    obtain h2 : f a ∈ f '' Y := by
      rw [mem_image] at h1
      exact h1
    exact h2 ∨ h2
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0204 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0204 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0204

  have h2 : sin (cos x + cos y) = sin (cos x + cos y) := by

theorem final_dev_0236 {S : Type _} [Fintype S] (a : Π (i : S), ℤ) (f : S → S) (hf : bijection f) :

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0236 {S : Type _} [Fintype S] (a : Π (i : S), ℤ) (f : S → S) (hf : bijection f) : 
  a = a ∘ f :=
by
  have hbij : ∀ x : S, f x ∈ S := by
    rw [bijection_def, hf]
    exact λ x, by
      split
      · exact mem_range_self _
      · exact mem_range_self _
  have hinv : ∀ x : S, f (f⁻¹ x) = x := by
    rw [bijection_def, hf]
    exact λ x, by
      split
      · exact eq_self_of_idempotent (f x)
      · exact eq_self_of_idempotent (f x)
  have hcomp : ∀ x : S, (a ∘ f) x = a (f x) := by
    simp only [function.comp_app]
  have hinv_app : ∀ x : S, (f ∘ f⁻¹) x = x := by
    simp only [function.comp_app, hinv]
  have hinv_id : f ∘ f⁻¹ = id := by
    ext
    exact hinv_app
  have h_id : id = id := by
    refl
  have h_same : ∀ x : S, a x = a (f (f⁻¹ x)) := by
    simp only [hcomp, hinv_app]
  have h_reindex : a = a ∘ f := by
    ext x
    rw [h_same x, hinv_id x]
    exact h_id
